content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common. Tonight, try a short, boring check-in when he wakes: go in, say one calm line like "night night, time to sleep," pat his back, and leave before he's fully worked up. Keep it the same every time, and give him a minute or two to resettle before you go in. If you feed or rock him back to sleep at 2am, he learns to need that to drop off, so that's usually the piece to change first.
